scripts.build: pnpm --filter zeroproof-backend prisma:generate && pnpm -r build && npm --prefix updater run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter zeroproof-backend lint && pnpm --filter zeroproof-frontend lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @uguard/unifi-client test && pnpm --filter zeroproof-backend test --runInBand && pnpm --filter zeroproof-frontend test run && npm --prefix updater test -- --runInBand
scripts.audit:deps: pnpm run audit:workspace && npm --prefix updater run audit:deps
scripts.check: pnpm audit:deps && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @uguard/unifi-client typecheck && pnpm test
